title: Frappe ERPNext 10.1.41 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in a…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 10.1.41 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the Manufacturing module. This flaw allows authenticated users with permission to create a BOM Update Log to replace one Bill of Materials (BOM) with another across all assemblies site-wide without proper authorization checks. The vulnerability can lead to unauthorized modification of BOMs, impacting data integrity.
